title: URPX Corpus Layout
description: Schema for corpus.json, which declares how to walk a corpus of URPX documents. Each kind's include globs are evaluated under every root. A walker's CLI, run from the repository root, prints repo-relative POSIX paths one per line in C-locale byte order: with no arguments the files of the kinds listed in documents, with kind names as arguments the files of those kinds, and with --all every kind as kind<TAB>path.

roots.description: Top-level directories the include globs are evaluated under.

include.description: Globs relative to each root. * matches any characters within one path segment; ** as a whole segment matches zero or more segments; every other character is literal.

documents.description: The kinds that make up the corpus documents, i.e. what a consumer loads.

cli.description: Command run from the repository root.
